803-1309-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-1309-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4311-4885-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1018-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1018-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
1018-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3899-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
3899-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
3899-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat from step 3.

2738-4871-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

489-1594-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2921-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-2921-4302.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1061-1409-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-1409-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Niko by paying {1}{U}, bling it.
When Niko enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Niko trigger, creating two Shard tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Niko.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1247-5963-7287.description:
Activate Marvin using Transdimensional Bovine's ability by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

851-967-2292-3809-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3835-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wylie Duke with "Kraken" chosen

1238-2351-3967-5467-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1477-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

575-5971-6826.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5971-6826.description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Yedora triggers, returning Masked Meower from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Masked Meower enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Masked Meower by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Masked Meower face-up.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

560-2034-4593-6719.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-6719.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3765-6102-6108.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-6102-6108.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-6102-6108.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

2538-3676-4052-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to return Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1115-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

647-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
647-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3259-4068-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1765-3018-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1183-1636-2773-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
1183-1636-2773-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Creature tokens enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

1461-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {C}{C}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine triggers, creating a 3/3 Wurm token with deathtouch and a 3/3 Wurm token with lifelink.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Wurm token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
